messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://microfluidics.utoronto.ca/papers/ncomms8513.pdf
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms8513

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Digital microfluidic Immunocytochemistry in Single Cells (DISC) for high-time-resolution analysis of PDGFR/PI3K/Akt phosphorylation signalling in adherent fibroblasts and breast cancer cells

REAGENTS USED:
  - Cell Suspension (NIH-3T3 fibroblasts, MCF-7, or MDA-MB-231 cells at 500,000 cells per mL in culture media; passively dispensed to form virtual microwells (VMs) on the patterned top-plate hydrophilic sites)
  - Starving Media (0.5% serum, 0.05% v/v Pluronic F68 in DMEM)
  - Serum-Free DMEM (0.05% v/v Pluronic F68 rinse/wash medium)
  - PDGF-BB Ligand (human recombinant PDGF-BB stimulant in serum-free DMEM, delivered as single-bolus or brief pulse doses)
  - Fixing Solution (4% paraformaldehyde, 0.05% v/v F68 in DPBS)
  - Wash Buffer 1 (0.05% v/v F68 in DPBS, post-fixation rinse)
  - Permeabilization Solution (0.2% v/v Tween-20 in DPBS)
  - Wash Buffer 2 (0.05% v/v Brij 35 in DPBS, post-permeabilization/antibody rinse)
  - Blocking Solution (1% bovine non-fat dried milk, 0.05% v/v Brij 35 in DPBS)
  - Primary Antibody Solution (anti-PDGFR/anti-phospho-PDGFR or anti-Akt/anti-phospho-Akt mouse and rabbit antibodies in blocking solution)
  - Secondary Antibody Solution (Alexa Fluor 647 anti-mouse and Alexa Fluor 555 anti-rabbit conjugates in blocking solution)

STEPS:
1. Seeding: Passively dispense cell suspension droplets onto the top-plate hydrophilic sites to form virtual microwells; incubate 24 h at 37 C to allow cell adherence.
2. Starving: Dispense starving media to the VM; incubate 24 h at 37 C to serum-starve adherent cells.
3. Rinse: Passively dispense six successive serum-free DMEM droplets across the VM to wash out starving media.
4. Stimulation: Deliver PDGF-BB ligand droplet(s) to the VM for a defined stimulation duration (single bolus of 1 s to 120 s, or a brief 3-40 s pulse followed by ligand-free wash-away, depending on experiment).
5. Fixation: Immediately after stimulation, dispense fixing solution to the VM and incubate 10 min at room temperature to arrest the signalling state.
6. Rinse: Passively dispense six successive Wash Buffer 1 droplets to remove residual fixing solution.
7. Permeabilization: Dispense permeabilization solution to the VM and incubate 10 min at room temperature.
8. Rinse: Passively dispense nine successive Wash Buffer 2 droplets to remove permeabilization solution.
9. Blocking: Dispense blocking solution to the VM and incubate 1 h at room temperature.
10. Primary Antibody Staining: Dispense primary antibody solution (target protein + phosphoprotein antibodies) to the VM and incubate overnight at 4 C.
11. Rinse: Passively dispense six successive Wash Buffer 2 droplets to remove unbound primary antibody.
12. Secondary Antibody Staining: Dispense secondary antibody solution to the VM and incubate 2 h at room temperature.
13. Detection: Disassemble the top plate and scan on a microarray/laser-scanning cytometer; analyze images in CellProfiler to compute, for each single cell, the ratio of phosphorylated-protein to total-protein (phosphorylated + non-phosphorylated) fluorescence intensity, normalized to unstimulated control cells on the same device, yielding a per-cell phosphorylation fold-change used to classify normal vs. hyperactive responders.

PULSE-STIMULATION VARIANT (time-resolved wash-away experiments, Fig. 6):
After seeding, starving, and rinsing as above, cells are stimulated with a brief PDGF-BB pulse (as short as 3 s) and then washed with ligand-free medium to terminate ligand exposure. Cells are held for a defined post-stimulation interval (1-5 min, in 1 min increments) before fixation, so that phosphorylation state is captured at successive time points after the pulse. Steps 5-12 (fixation, permeabilization, blocking, primary/secondary antibody staining, and washes) are then performed identically to the standard protocol, followed by detection/classification of Akt activation.

INTERPRETATION: Successful DISC operation is confirmed by dose-dependent, bulk-averaged PDGFR/Akt phosphorylation curves matching conventional (western blot) measurements of the PDGFR/PI3K/Akt pathway, Hill-coefficient/half-maximal-activation values consistent with prior literature, no significant signalling perturbation from droplet-movement shear stress, and single-cell-resolved histograms/scatter plots revealing heterogeneous "hyperactive responder" subpopulations (e.g., in MDA-MB-231 vs. MCF-7 breast cancer cells) and fast pulse-stimulation kinetics (e.g., a 10 s PDGF pulse committing >30% of cells to Akt activation) not resolvable by traditional bulk assays.

identity.protocol_name: Digital Microfluidic Immunocytochemistry in Single Cells (DISC) for PDGFR/PI3K/Akt Phosphorylation Signalling (Ng et al. 2015)

source.title: Digital microfluidic Immunocytochemistry in Single Cells (DISC) for high-time-resolution analysis of PDGFR/PI3K/Akt phosphorylation signalling in adherent fibroblasts and breast cancer cells

ir.content:
main:
	vm1[0] = dispense(CellSuspension)
	heat(vm1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	starve1[0] = dispense(StarvingMedia)
	vm2[0] = mix(vm1[0], starve1[0])
	heat(vm2[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI REPEAT_61 = {REPEAT_60,REPEAT_62}
	PHI sfd1 = {sfd0,sfd2}
	PHI vm3 = {vm2,vm4}
	if REPEAT_61[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	sfd2[0] = dispense(SerumFreeDMEM)
	vm4[0] = mix(vm3[0], sfd2[0])
	REPEAT_62[0] = REPEAT_61[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
	ligand1[0] = dispense(PDGF_BB)
	vm5[0] = mix(vm3[0], ligand1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	fs1[0] = dispense(FixingSolution)
	vm6[0] = mix(vm5[0], fs1[0])
	heat(vm6[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
bsbbr_5_h:
	PHI wb11 = {wb10,wb12}
	PHI REPEAT_63 = {REPEAT_61,REPEAT_64}
	PHI vm7 = {vm6,vm8}
	if REPEAT_63[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_6_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_7_f
bsbbr_6_t:
	wb12[0] = dispense(WashBuffer1)
	vm8[0] = mix(vm7[0], wb12[0])
	REPEAT_64[0] = REPEAT_63[0] - 1
bsbbr_7_f:
	ps1[0] = dispense(PermeabilizationSolution)
	vm9[0] = mix(vm7[0], ps1[0])
	heat(vm9[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
bsbbr_8_h:
	PHI REPEAT_91 = {REPEAT_90,REPEAT_92}
	PHI wb21 = {wb20,wb22}
	PHI vm10 = {vm9,vm11}
	if REPEAT_91[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_9_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_10_f
bsbbr_9_t:
	wb22[0] = dispense(WashBuffer2)
	vm11[0] = mix(vm10[0], wb22[0])
	REPEAT_92[0] = REPEAT_91[0] - 1
bsbbr_10_f:
	bs1[0] = dispense(BlockingSolution)
	vm12[0] = mix(vm10[0], bs1[0])
	heat(vm12[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	pab1[0] = dispense(PrimaryAntibody)
	vm13[0] = mix(vm12[0], pab1[0])
	heat(vm13[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 43200.0SECOND
bsbbr_11_h:
	PHI wb2b1 = {wb2b0,wb2b2}
	PHI REPEAT_65 = {REPEAT_63,REPEAT_66}
	PHI vm14 = {vm13,vm15}
	if REPEAT_65[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_12_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_13_f
bsbbr_12_t:
	wb2b2[0] = dispense(WashBuffer2)
	vm15[0] = mix(vm14[0], wb2b2[0])
	REPEAT_66[0] = REPEAT_65[0] - 1
bsbbr_13_f:
	sab1[0] = dispense(SecondaryAntibody)
	vm16[0] = mix(vm14[0], sab1[0])
	heat(vm16[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 7200.0SECOND
	PhosphoSignal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, vm16[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if PhosphoSignal1[0] >= 30	|	true: jump bsbbif_14_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_15_f
bsbbif_14_t:
	dispose(vm16[0])
bsbbif_15_f:
	dispose(vm16[0])
	jump: bsbbif_16_j
bsbbif_16_j:
	pulse_vm1[0] = dispense(CellSuspension)
	heat(pulse_vm1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	pulse_starve1[0] = dispense(StarvingMedia)
	pulse_vm2[0] = mix(pulse_vm1[0], pulse_starve1[0])
	heat(pulse_vm2[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
bsbbr_17_h:
	PHI pulse_sfd1 = {pulse_sfd0,pulse_sfd2}
	PHI pulse_vm3 = {pulse_vm2,pulse_vm4}
	PHI REPEAT_67 = {REPEAT_65,REPEAT_68}
	if REPEAT_67[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_18_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_19_f
bsbbr_18_t:
	pulse_sfd2[0] = dispense(SerumFreeDMEM)
	pulse_vm4[0] = mix(pulse_vm3[0], pulse_sfd2[0])
	REPEAT_68[0] = REPEAT_67[0] - 1
bsbbr_19_f:
	pulse_ligand1[0] = dispense(PDGF_BB)
	pulse_vm5[0] = mix(pulse_vm3[0], pulse_ligand1[0]) @ 3.0SECOND
	wash_away1[0] = dispense(SerumFreeDMEM)
	pulse_vm6[0] = mix(pulse_vm5[0], wash_away1[0])
bsbbr_20_h:
	PHI REPEAT_51 = {REPEAT_50,REPEAT_52}
	PHI pulse_vm7 = {pulse_vm6,pulse_vm7}
	if REPEAT_51[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_21_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_22_f
bsbbr_21_t:
	heat(pulse_vm7[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 60.0SECOND
	REPEAT_52[0] = REPEAT_51[0] - 1
bsbbr_22_f:
	pulse_fs1[0] = dispense(FixingSolution)
	pulse_vm8[0] = mix(pulse_vm7[0], pulse_fs1[0])
	heat(pulse_vm8[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
bsbbr_23_h:
	PHI pulse_wb11 = {pulse_wb10,pulse_wb12}
	PHI pulse_vm9 = {pulse_vm8,pulse_vm10}
	PHI REPEAT_69 = {REPEAT_67,REPEAT_610}
	if REPEAT_69[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_24_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_25_f
bsbbr_24_t:
	pulse_wb12[0] = dispense(WashBuffer1)
	pulse_vm10[0] = mix(pulse_vm9[0], pulse_wb12[0])
	REPEAT_610[0] = REPEAT_69[0] - 1
bsbbr_25_f:
	pulse_ps1[0] = dispense(PermeabilizationSolution)
	pulse_vm11[0] = mix(pulse_vm9[0], pulse_ps1[0])
	heat(pulse_vm11[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
bsbbr_26_h:
	PHI pulse_wb21 = {pulse_wb20,pulse_wb22}
	PHI pulse_vm12 = {pulse_vm11,pulse_vm13}
	PHI REPEAT_93 = {REPEAT_91,REPEAT_94}
	if REPEAT_93[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_27_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_28_f
bsbbr_27_t:
	pulse_wb22[0] = dispense(WashBuffer2)
	pulse_vm13[0] = mix(pulse_vm12[0], pulse_wb22[0])
	REPEAT_94[0] = REPEAT_93[0] - 1
bsbbr_28_f:
	pulse_bs1[0] = dispense(BlockingSolution)
	pulse_vm14[0] = mix(pulse_vm12[0], pulse_bs1[0])
	heat(pulse_vm14[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	pulse_pab1[0] = dispense(PrimaryAntibody)
	pulse_vm15[0] = mix(pulse_vm14[0], pulse_pab1[0])
	heat(pulse_vm15[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 43200.0SECOND
bsbbr_29_h:
	PHI pulse_wb2b1 = {pulse_wb2b0,pulse_wb2b2}
	PHI pulse_vm16 = {pulse_vm15,pulse_vm17}
	PHI REPEAT_611 = {REPEAT_69,REPEAT_612}
	if REPEAT_611[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_30_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_31_f
bsbbr_30_t:
	pulse_wb2b2[0] = dispense(WashBuffer2)
	pulse_vm17[0] = mix(pulse_vm16[0], pulse_wb2b2[0])
	REPEAT_612[0] = REPEAT_611[0] - 1
bsbbr_31_f:
	pulse_sab1[0] = dispense(SecondaryAntibody)
	pulse_vm18[0] = mix(pulse_vm16[0], pulse_sab1[0])
	heat(pulse_vm18[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 7200.0SECOND
	AktSignal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, pulse_vm18[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if AktSignal1[0] >= 32	|	true: jump bsbbif_32_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_33_f
bsbbif_32_t:
	dispose(pulse_vm18[0])
bsbbif_33_f:
	dispose(pulse_vm18[0])
	jump: bsbbif_34_j
bsbbif_34_j:
	NOP

numeric_mismatches.note: Unlike the DBS punch (a persistent solid substrate re-dispensed each step because BioScript has no substrate primitive), the DISC virtual microwell genuinely is a single continuously-updated liquid droplet in the paper (sequential passive dispensing displaces its contents in place), so representing it as one repeatedly-mixed 'vm' handle is a faithful model, not a workaround.

numeric_mismatches.field: overnight primary antibody incubation modeled as 12h
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper states primary antibody incubation is 'overnight' without a specific duration; BioScript requires a concrete time value, so 12h was chosen as a representative overnight incubation length.

numeric_mismatches.field: stimulation duration parameterization (10s in main block, 3s in pulse block)
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper tests a range of single-bolus durations (1-120s) and pulse durations (3-40s) across multiple figures; the BioScript translation fixes one representative duration per block (10s bolus, 3s pulse) rather than modeling the full parameter sweep, since BioScript has no native loop-over-parameter-set construct matching the experimental design.

The paper defines hyperactive responders statistically via an outlier-plot quartile method (75th percentile + 1.5x IQR of p-Akt fold change), not a fixed numeric threshold; the if/else threshold here is an illustrative stand-in for that statistical classification step, since BioScript's grammar only supports simple numeric comparisons.

numeric_mismatches.field: DropBot actuation/voltage control system, CellProfiler shape/neighbour analysis, microarray scanner/live-cell imaging hardware, shear-stress and orthovanadate control experiments, double-bolus ligand-renewal experiment
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. These are device-control, image-analysis, or separate control/validation sub-experiments run alongside the core seed/stimulate/fix/stain/detect protocol, not part of the 11-step immunocytochemistry procedure itself, and fall outside the scope of this translation.

metadata.notes: This protocol details Digital microfluidic Immunocytochemistry in Single Cells (DISC) for high-time-resolution analysis of PDGFR/PI3K/Akt phosphorylation signalling in adherent fibroblasts and breast cancer cells. The assay is performed on a Digital Microfluidics (DMF) platform. Key reagents used in the assay include Cell Suspension and Starving Media.
